en.name: Function Plot
en.description: Graphs of functions, one per line: sin(x), x^2 - 1.
en.tool.check_function_plot: Checks the source of a ```function-plot block - functions of x, one per line, with + - * / ^, brackets, pi, e and the usual functions - before it goes into a document, without drawing it. Returns ok, or the problems to fix first. Pass the source without its fence, and the fence's words (xmin=0 xmax=100) as meta.
